name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
label: Quest
description: Zaeldarr the Outcast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Can you believe that, after all the trouble we have in the plaguelands... We have to worry about thieves too? And not just normal thieves, troll thieves.
And not just normal troll thieves. Dead troll thieves!

They're led by this big, dead troll named Zaeldarr the Outcast, and they come here at night and steal bodies from the pit below, then take them back to their evil, dead troll hideout--the Undercroft to the west.
Go there and take out Zaeldarr, friend. I'm sick to death of his mischief!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the hideout, friend? Did you take care of Zaeldarr?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got him! And I hope you taught his gang a lesson too!
